text: I'm the stepdad and I've been up with her since about 9 so apologies if this doesn't make total sense. My stepdaughter is 9. She's had a temperature today, it was 39.5 when I checked about half an hour ago. Then about ten minutes ago she had what I can only call a fit. She went stiff all over, her arms and legs were shaking and her eyes rolled up so you could only see the whites. It lasted maybe a minute or two, I wasn't timing it properly. This has never happened to her before, not once. Her mum is away for work and I'm on my own with her and her brother. She's come round now but she's shivering like mad, teeth chattering, and her hands and feet are freezing cold when I touch them, which seems mad because she's that hot. She's breathing normally, I've been watching her chest and it's going in and out fine, nothing strange there. I don't know if I should be calling an ambulance or what to do next. I'm absolutely shattered and I don't want to get this wrong.
